name: stale_aggregate
description: In `app.put('/api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber')`, line items are updated (l_extendedprice, l_discount, l_tax) but `orders.o_totalprice` is not recalculated and updated. The read endpoint `app.get('/api/orders/:o_orderkey')` returns this stale `o_totalprice` value, which no longer reflects the actual sum of line items.
